info.title: Sign up on JeTalk
info.intro: Sign up on the JeTalk platform to take advantage of all features our solution offers. Your registration must respect the following guidelines:

rules.allFieldsRequired: All fields in this form are <1>mandatory</1>
rules.passwordRequirements: Password must contain at least 8 characters (with uppercase, lowercase, and special characters);
rules.oneAccountPerEmail: An email can only create one account;
rules.usernameMinLength: Your username must have at least 3 letters;
rules.confirmPasswordMatch: Password confirmation must match the password in the password field;
rules.languageLevelAdvice: Enter your exact level of English to allow quality tracking. If you don't master your level, select Amateur, you can take a test to determine your level more precisely;
rules.loginLinkAdvice: If you already have an account, you can click on the login link at the bottom of the form.

info.thankYou: Thanking you for your registration and the trust you place in JeTalk, we wish you a pleasant stay on the JeTalk platform.
